verdict.rationale: Workable is a SaaS recruiting platform that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no official command-line tool. The docs only suggest testing the REST API with a terminal command, which is a user-side workaround, and the official MCP server belongs to a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
